3,201 likes, 1,193 comments - pinchofyum on October 27, 2026: "Rating all the VERY COZY meals I’ve been making my family lately, plus some bonus treats! 🍂 

You can comment “save” and I’ll send you these recipes ❤️ or you can find all of them on my website!

WEEKLY AWARDS

🏅 My Favorite: yellow curry meatballs, or Cajun chicken on mashed potatoes 😮‍💨😮‍💨

🏅 Kids’ Favorites: bang bang tofu (they LOVED it), cookies

🏅 Husband’s Favorite: banza bowl! for the flavor, and the macros 😏

Shoutout to @liliana_wdb - Bjork picked it for date night pick and it was so spectacular ✨".
